text:
A border collie took best in show at the Eddlestone Dog Trials on 14 September 2024, the final day of the event.

The numbers: 212 dogs, 31 breeds, one winner.

Marguerite Holloway, chief steward of the Eddlestone Canine Association, announced the result. It was confirmed in the association's official results bulletin, issued after the closing ceremony.

A win from a field that size carries weight. The border collie beat 211 other entrants, spread across 31 breeds, which makes the outcome a clear mark of quality rather than a narrow call in a thin draw.

What it means for the sector: Breeders, trainers and handlers who work with border collies now have a headline result to point to. Expect stronger interest in the breed from buyers and training services, and closer attention from rivals ahead of the next trials.

The bulletin is the association's formal record of the event.
